visitors.name: Biscuit
visitors.bio: Just happened to be in the neighborhood. Coincidence? Probably not — Biscuit knows exactly where the good donuts are.
visitors.spawn_flavor: A mysterious golden cat is eyeing your glazed donuts.

visitors.name: Mochi
visitors.bio: Wanders in from somewhere unspecified. Claims it's 'just passing through.' It has been here seven times.
visitors.spawn_flavor: A round, suspicious cat has materialized near the sprinkle donuts.

visitors.name: Pretzel
visitors.bio: A cat shaped vaguely like a pretzel when asleep. Visits for the ambiance, mostly. Judges the frosting choices silently.
visitors.spawn_flavor: A pretzel-shaped lump has settled near the counter, judging everything.

visitors.name: Cheddar
visitors.bio: Nobody knows where Cheddar came from. Nobody has asked. Some mysteries are better left unsolved.
visitors.spawn_flavor: An orange cat of unknown origin is sitting in your shop.

visitors.name: Cloudy
visitors.bio: Only appears when it's raining. Has strong opinions about petrichor. Brings their own tiny umbrella (won't share).
visitors.spawn_flavor: A damp, mysterious cat has dripped in from the rain.

visitors.name: Vesper
visitors.bio: The Midnight Tuxedo Cat arrives fashionably late. Refuses to explain what they were doing before 10 PM. Very dignified.
visitors.spawn_flavor: A tuxedo cat has appeared, impeccably dressed, asking no questions.
